title: A push to a PR branch whose newest review round passed asks until that round's record is posted
why: Lanes lint-before-record-push (#1755, 21:30 CST) and archive-refuses-unpr-branch (#1744, about 20:57 CST) each pushed a fix before posting the round's record, so the tool could not write a fix-check record and a fresh round was needed. Incident (consultant 00:24 CST Nov 14, relayed; from a lane's draft retrospective the owner pasted, lane unnamed): a lane pushed fixes before posting the review result, so the merge tool refused the fix-check record (it needs an earlier posted log and prints a record only for the live head) and a fresh round 1 replaced four rounds on old heads. Owner priority fb-1556-6 (cut repetition).
note: Related: reviewed-head-push-ask (#1725) asks only when a record with a Fix check exists; this is the no-record-yet case. fix-push-needs-fail-record covers a FAIL round with no record; this covers a PASS round. Coordinator 21:31 CST Nov 7; filed 21:33 CST. Incident 3: lane auto-merge-refused (#1763) had no review record after rounds 1 and 2 (coordinator, 21:41 CST Nov 7). Incident 4: lane notes-fix-page ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-page]) pushed a notes fix on #1733 before posting its round-3 record; merge --review-record refused both heads, which cost one extra sonnet recheck. Guard candidate: the merge refusal names the order, record first, then the push (coordinator, 22:20 CST Nov 7). Incident 5 (the coordinator counted it as the third): lane coordinator-pick-needs-record pushed a notes commit to #1771 after a round-2 PASS whose comment had no record marker, so no fix-check record was possible. The round-2 record was re-posted at the new head, and a haiku fix check covered the notes diff. Lane's guard: a reviewer posts its record through `merge --review-record` before it reports PASS, and a lane push after a PASS checks that a marker-form record exists for the head it pushes from (coordinator, 22:52 CST Nov 7). Nov 7 23:07 CST: covered by open PR #1538 (Refuse a push that follows a review round with no posted record; decision push-needs-review-record; case fail-then-fail-pass in hooks/test_guard.py 5f-2). Lane [ended:lane:-record-before-fix-push] built nothing and closes after a suite verdict. Done when #1538 merges. Lane notes-fix-page restated incident 4 at 23:14 CST; nothing new. #1538 covers it. #1538 has a new head 7069134a2, and #1801 (6cd9712e3, replaces #1610, #1624 and #1628) is with runner 8; lane fix-push-needs-fail-record ended (coordinator, 00:49 CST Nov 8). Third sighting, folded here (lane merge-passes-settings-dir, 01:04 CST Nov 8; suggested slug review-record-before-fix-push): the lane pushed a fix before round 1's record existed, so the merge tool could not record round 1 or the fix check, and a real round 2 was spent.
